comment: THE FOREIGN SENSOR REGISTRY — one row, whose command is this fixture's own script and whose bound is 1. The row's class and category are the foreign vocabulary's, so the runner exercises the registry indirection against values no engine knows.

classTypes.comment: The tracker type a row's class files its item as — the fixture's own names rather than the upstream project's, because a type is the tracker account's and no engine may name one (design D12): an engine that knew `Bug` would pass this mapping by accident. A class neither the row nor this mapping names is refused as `row-type-unmapped` before any filing.

escalation.comment: Two reopenings, then a person. Different from the upstream project's three, so the escalation shape is a fixture fact rather than a copy.
